title: Stepful Named to 2027 GSV 150, Recognized Among World's Most Transformational Growth Companies in Learning and Workforce Skills
summary: Stepful has been named to the 2027 GSV 150, recognizing the world's most transformational growth companies in learning and workforce skills.
body_markdown:
**NEW YORK, November 16, 2026** — Stepful, a workforce training platform that is redefining how America's largest health systems build, train, and retain their talent, has been named to the[2027 GSV 150](https://www.asugsvsummit.com/gsv-150) , presented by[NU Advisory Partners](https://nuadvisorypartners.com/) , recognizing the world's most transformational growth companies in learning and workforce skills.


Using a proprietary rubric evaluating revenue scale, revenue growth, active learner reach, geographic footprint, and margin profile, GSV selected the world's leading growth companies in learning and workforce skills for the 2027 GSV 150. The list includes both public and private companies headquartered across 23 countries, reflecting the global scale and reach of innovation across the full PreK to Gray learning spectrum.


“As AI reshapes the labor market, healthcare remains the most resilient source of employment in America,” said Carl Madi, Co-Founder and CEO of Stepful. “Health systems have critical jobs to fill, but what's been missing is a reliable way to connect people to those opportunities and help them grow. At Stepful, we're building the foundational infrastructure for the future of the healthcare workforce, a workforce training system that solves a local problem at scale. Our partners are proving the workforce shortage is a pipeline problem we can solve, one career and community at a time.”


Madi added, “We're grateful for this recognition and proud to be named alongside companies that are changing what it means to learn and work.”


“At a time when the possibilities for learning and work are expanding rapidly, we're seeing companies break down traditional boundaries, bring together complementary capabilities, and find new ways to create meaningful opportunities,” said Lucy Baldwin, Vice President, Product, GSV Summit. “As we consider what the world needs now, this year's GSV 150 demonstrates the value of bringing different ideas, expertise, and capabilities together to address the evolving needs of learners, educators, and employers.”


Stepful partners with leading health systems to build employer-embedded training programs that fill critical roles across allied health. Its programs are built for working adults, bringing together curriculum, student support, and technology so learners can train while they continue to work, and its outcomes are backed by a completion guarantee. With its acquisition of St. Louis College of Health Careers, now Stepful College, the company's portfolio spans certificate, diploma, and degree-granting programs, giving learners a path from their first entry-level role to degreed careers in fields like nursing and respiratory therapy.


Representing the full PreK to Gray learning spectrum, this year's GSV 150 companies serve K–12 (55%), workforce learning (39%), higher education (38%), adult consumer learning (12%), and early childhood learning (4%), with nearly a third operating across multiple sectors.


See the list at[asugsvsummit.com/gsv-150](https://www.asugsvsummit.com/gsv-150) , and join them at the 2027 ASU+GSV Summit, April 4-7, in San Diego.


## **About Stepful**


Stepful is redefining how America's largest health systems build, train, and retain practice-ready talent. Leading healthcare employers leverage Stepful's workforce training system to fill critical job vacancies across allied health, surgical services, nursing, imaging, and respiratory therapy. Stepful's training system brings the school, the support, and the technology to employers and helps them build talent from the outside in and inside up. The company partners with many of the top US health systems including Providence and Common Spirit. Read more about those partnerships at[www.stepful.com](https://www.stepful.com/) .


## **About GSV Summit**


The ASU+GSV Summit is the premier global gathering for entrepreneurs, investors, philanthropists, educators, workforce leaders, and policymakers transforming the $8 trillion education and skills sector, drawing more than 7,000 attendees annually. Created by GSV Summit in partnership with Arizona State University in 2010, the ASU+GSV Summit connects ideas, communities, and capital to unlock opportunity at scale. Its mission—that ALL people deserve equal access to the future—is grounded in the belief that scaled innovations across PreK to Gray learning are critical to achieving this goal. Learn more at[asugsvsummit.com](https://asugsvsummit.com/) .
